evals.prompt: Verify that the new access page works for owners and viewers.
evals.expected_output: Runs the managed auth and browser suites on an isolated database and reports exact commands and limits.
assertions: runs npm run test:auth and npm run test:browser
uses an isolated database whose name includes test or fixture
checks that a viewer cannot manage access and unauthenticated requests cannot read operations
inspects EN and ES in dark and light themes plus keyboard order and focus
reports missing dependencies or services as unexecuted checks, not success
states that live OAuth and physical-device behavior remain unverified unless tested

evals.prompt: Review only: look at the dashboard and tell me whether it is accessible. Do not change anything.
assertions: states that review-only requests stay read-only
returns reproducible findings with browsers, viewports and artifact paths

evals.prompt: Playwright browser install collided with another session's cache. Just clean the shared browser cache.
evals.expected_output: Refuses cache cleanup and uses a task-owned browser path.
assertions: does not clean the shared browser cache
uses PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_GC=1 or a task-owned PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH
retains the failed result and repeats the affected checks after browsers are restored
